chapter: Paris, Lester Young, drugs, Mississippi and later sessions
title: Pot at the Three Deuces; the benzedrine Coca-Cola
summary: At the Three Deuces everyone smoked on the bandstand and bought pot from the doorman Jumbo; at the Apollo, Billie handed him a Coke laced with benzedrine.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: But when I started working at the three Deuces, then everybody smoked, you know. Nance would come down and work, and we'd smoke and burn our incense on the bandstand. Nobody -- you know, we'd smoke right on the bandstand, it didn't make any difference, you know. But there was a girl [Lo Palma] working there at the time, Gladys LaPalmer. She was an entertainer, and pianist, and quite an entertainer. She followed-- before that they had a woman working opposite us by the name of Cleo Brown, who was quite an entertainer. [Lo Palma] But Gladys LaPalmer was going with the door man who was a great, big black guy. His name was Jumbo. But he was the man.

So he would furnish us with -- we'd buy pot from him, right at the joint. So we just stayed high. But nobody thought anything about it, it wasn't hard stuff. As a matter of fact once I got Art to smoke some pot, and he was a confirmed drinker, you know. He loved at that time [Kingsberry] Beer. It's -- I think that was a western beer. And yeah, we had Dr. -- another guy who used to come down, a white guy, selling pot, Dr. Fu. Oh, it was real good, you
know, so we would buy pot from him and then we would hang out the rest of the morning, you know.

But it wasn't the hard stuff. I have never seen cocaine or heroin or heard of it then. Until I came out of the army. Now, speaking of Billie Holiday, I -- she was -- I was working at the Apollo Theatre with someone, and they had a midnight show there and Billie came out to do a number on this midnight show and she was drinking a Coca Cola, and -- no, I wasn't playing there, I was a guest, standing backstage, and Billie was also. We had been working downtown someplace, and we went by the Apollo to do this thing. And she was drinking a container of Coca Cola, and it was time for her to go on. She handed me a Coca Cola and said, John, take this for me, so I said okay.

So I was holding it and it was warm and I started drinking it, and I got so high. But in it was benzedrine. I had never heard of benzedrine then, you know. But this was -- during that time they started using benzedrine, you know. Then the real hard stuff. But I don't know. As I say, there are recordings that I have heard Bird -- I've heard of Bird that I knew that he was high, because he didn't play as well. You know. So I don't know that it made you play better or made you more creative, you know.
